meta.source: NutriSen pitch decks (KWS visit, Rootcamp Oct 2026, Bayer pitch Nov 2026)

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide and page background. Light: every content slide. Blue: the single closing slide.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles that belong to the plan / partner side (light); content cards on the blue slide.

tokens.name: surface-neutral
tokens.usage: Tiles for today's alternatives (status quo). Never for NutriSen.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface, surface-tint and surface-neutral (10.9:1 / 9.6:1 / 9.7:1; white on blue 8.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, column headers, company names. FLAG: #7a7a7a is 4.3:1 on white and 3.8:1 on surface-tint, so only at 18px+ (14pt+); for smaller text use ink.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Slide titles, card headings, stat numbers in blue, names. 8.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: NutriSen blue, the dominant brand colour: titles, logo, the soil-test bar, the blue closing slide.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: NutriSen green: the solution / NutriSen itself, the 50% stat, number circles, the NutriSen bar and tile. FLAG: 2.8:1 on white, so only for fills, icons and text at 28px+ bold as in the deck; never for small text.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Added for accessibility (not in the deck): green for text under 24px on white (5.0:1). Blue theme: eyebrow green on #004d9d (5.1:1).

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above every slide title (deck value, 28px). FLAG: on light only at the 28px eyebrow size; use green-text below that.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-blue (8.2:1). On brand-green only bold 28px+ (2.8:1, flag).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and above contact blocks. Decorative only.

tokens.name: neutral-icon
tokens.usage: Icon circles on alternative (status-quo) tiles, timeline dots and axis line (#9a9a9a in the deck).

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: The ✕ marker in front of a limitation. 4.4:1 on white; always paired with the ✕ glyph, never colour alone.

tokens.name: wheat
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the ripe-wheat icon on the season timeline (May/June). Never text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Title slide headline only. PowerPoint: 69 pt, colour heading.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers (50%, -30%, €15 B). PowerPoint: 72–78 pt. Green for NutriSen results, blue for market/context figures.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: From a winter plan to in-season precision
styles.usage: Slide title, top-left, one line where possible. PowerPoint: 49.5 pt, colour heading.

styles.name: stat-sm
styles.usage: Secondary figures (business model, entry market). PowerPoint: 44 pt.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Single-use nutrient biosensor for plant sap
styles.usage: Subtitle on the title slide. PowerPoint: 30 pt, colour ink.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Card and person headings. PowerPoint: 24–27 pt, heading colour (white on blue).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker above every title, colour eyebrow. PowerPoint: 21 pt, character spacing 1.7 pt.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Results directly on site in a few minutes.
styles.usage: Body copy on slides. PowerPoint: 22.5 pt, colour ink.

styles.name: tile
styles.usage: Tile notes, pros/cons, goal descriptions. PowerPoint: 20 pt.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table headers, month labels, page numbers. PowerPoint: 18 pt, ink-muted.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Sources and definitions at the slide bottom. PowerPoint: 11–15 pt, ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value, icon and text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing inside cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a row (0.2M EMU in the deck).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and card groups; card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between title block and content; between tile groups.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Left/right slide margin (1.15 in = 1,047,750 EMU). Eyebrow sits 90px from the top, title 138px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles, goal cards, fund cards (roundRect adj ≈ 7000).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels: CTA card, backup columns, entry-market card (roundRect adj 4000).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Timeline bars, status pills (Nitrate · validated), number circles.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: NutriSen uses no shadows: separation comes from tinted fills and whitespace.
